message.content:
This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a black background. At the top, a red horizontal bar sits above white text: "Prabowo Mencari Sekondan H.26" on the left and "Berpacu Menekan Sampah Plastik H.88" on the right. Below this, the word "TEMPO" appears in large, white, serif capital letters, with "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" in smaller letters underneath. A barcode, QR code, and price information are in the top right.

The central focus is a circular illustration resembling a telescope's crosshair view. Inside, a painted caricature of a man with dark hair and wide eyes is depicted. He wears a light-colored uniform with two gold stars on each shoulder lapel. He is looking slightly to the left with an open mouth. Thin black crosshair lines intersect over his face.

At the bottom, large white text reads "SKENARIO SAMBO". Below it, smaller text states: "Inspektur Jenderal Ferdy Sambo ditahan karena pelanggaran kode etik di sekitar pembunuhan Brigadir Yosua. Sejauh mana keterlibatannya? H.64".
